tagline: The world's most congestion-bound luxury coastline — where the sea is the relief valve and willingness-to-pay is the highest in the Med.
summary: The Amalfi Coast and Capri are the definition of a coastline whose road infrastructure has been overwhelmed by its own demand. The single coastal road (SS163) is gridlocked all summer; Capri takes up to 50,000 visitors on peak days against a tiny resident base and has capped day-trippers at 4,500, while Amalfi's quay sees long ferry queues for Capri and the islands. The result is a market where the water is already the preferred axis — Naples, Sorrento, Positano, Amalfi, Capri and Salerno are linked by a dense seasonal fast-ferry and private-tender network — and where guests pay a premium for speed, quiet and a guaranteed seat. Every core leg sits inside the Pioneer II envelope. A quiet, wake-light, zero-emission foiling craft is uniquely suited to the marine-sensitive Sorrento/Punta Campanella protected waters and to the ultra-premium hotel and charter clientele.

navier_fit.pioneer_ii: Pioneer II owns the entire Amalfi/Capri/Flegrean network — Sorrento↔Capri (~12 nm), Naples↔Capri (~17 nm), Positano↔Amalfi↔Salerno (~14 nm), Naples↔Ischia/Procida (~18 nm). All core legs inside the 70 nm all-electric envelope; wake-light foiling suits the Punta Campanella marine-protected waters.
navier_fit.quanta_lr: Quanta-LR (H2 2026+) reaches the Aeolian and Pontine islands on charging-independent long legs.

competitive_landscape: Caremar, SNAV, Alilauro and Travelmar run dense seasonal fast-ferry service today — strong demand proof — but it is diesel, wake-heavy and congestion-bound, with peak-day caps now in force. The market already pays a premium for private tenders and helicopter transfers; a quiet, guaranteed-seat foiling tier slots between scheduled ferry and helicopter. No zero-emission foiling operator runs the coast.
seasonality: Highly seasonal — Apr–Oct peak, intense Jun–Sep, near-dormant in winter. The congestion and cap pressures are acute in peak summer, which is precisely when premium guaranteed-seat capacity commands the most value.
regulatory_note: Italian flag / EU regime; Capitaneria di Porto (Italian Coast Guard) oversight; Punta Campanella is a Marine Protected Area favouring low-impact, zero-emission, wake-light craft. Capri's day-visitor cap and the region's overtourism-management push create a policy tailwind for higher-value, lower-volume premium marine mobility. EU FuelEU Maritime adds emissions pressure on diesel ferries.
